## Changing a style with Posit Assistant

**Your own table styles &middot; Page 5**\
*Like page 4, it will stand on its own.*

This page is on the way. It will show the kind of change page 4,
[Changing a style with an AI assistant](tables-ai-assistant.qmd), makes, this
time with Posit Assistant, the AI assistant that works inside RStudio, in its
sidebar. Posit Assistant can see your R session, so its route will
likely be shorter than page 4's, with no copy to upload and no file to
download.

Posit Assistant needs a paid subscription from Posit, the company that makes
RStudio, and RStudio sometimes has a free trial available. Until this page is
ready, page 4's route works with an AI assistant outside RStudio, such as
Microsoft Copilot.
